title: Interact with a running program
description:
As the student, I want to answer a program's prompts while it runs.

Feature: Interactive programs
  Scenario: Prompt and response
    Given a program that asks for a name and then greets it
    When the session is started
    Then the event stream shows the prompt
    When the student posts the line Ada to stdin
    Then the event stream shows the greeting Hello, Ada
